title: Sort metal from plastic
brief: Start and Stop run the conveyor. Metal parts must be pushed into Bin A by the diverter; plastic parts ride on to Bin B. The metal sensor is earlier on the belt than the diverter, so the program must remember what it saw.
hints: The diverter is at the photo-eye, but only the metal sensor can tell metal from plastic, and it is upstream (earlier on the belt).
Latch a memory tag (set coil) when the metal sensor sees a part.
Divert when the photo-eye sees a part and the memory is set; reset the memory when the part leaves the photo-eye (a falling-edge contact).

scenarios.name: Metal to Bin A, plastic to Bin B

assertions.says: Three metal parts should be in Bin A by now.
No plastic part should be in Bin A.
The plastic part that has reached the end should be in Bin B.

scenarios.hint: Latch MetalSeen when Prox sees a part; divert when Eye sees a part and MetalSeen is set; reset MetalSeen when the part leaves the eye (a falling-edge contact of Eye).

scenarios.name: Stop stops the belt

assertions.says: With the belt stopped, no new parts should come on.

scenarios.hint: StopPB is TRUE until Stop is pressed: a normally open contact of it in the belt's seal-in rung.

assertions.says: No plastic part should ever be diverted.
No metal part should reach Bin B.
